Our Story

From ATL flavor to Hinesville.

Slang 'N Platez ATL has grown from its food-truck roots into a Hinesville destination. The Liberty County Chamber documented the restaurant's Hinesville ribbon cutting in September 2024 at 1310 Shaw Road.

The goal of this section is to give the business a real identity—not just a menu and phone number.
